fact: Stanbic Bank Zambia launched direct renminbi settlement for Zambia-China trade over China's CIPS in Lusaka on 23 September 2026, per the commerce ministry and the bank.
COMESA, with EU funding, is supporting deployment of its Digital Retail Payment Platform across eight pilot countries including Zambia, with an implementation plan still to be drawn up.

MTN MoMo Zambia introduced direct wallet-to-bank transfers in January 2026, the first Zambian mobile money provider to let customers send funds to international bank accounts in the EU, UK and Canada, per ITWeb Africa.
